signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-19 ppt-web-core errorHandler backend-message passthrough)
evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/errorHandler.ts:221 (`message: data.message || errorInfo.message`) renders the RAW backend `ErrorResponse.message` verbatim as the user-facing error message for EVERY structured error response, regardless of HTTP status class. There is no status-based scrubbing: a 5xx (INTERNAL_ERROR / SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) that arrives with a structured body takes the `data.message` branch and shows the backend string directly, instead of falling back to the localized generic `errors.catalogue.INTERNAL_ERROR.message` copy. The file header (lines 6-10) documents this as intentional ("raw backend `message`s are passed through untranslated"), but the design trusts the backend to never place internal detail (SQL text, panic strings, internal identifiers, upstream stack fragments) in `message` on server-class errors — a fragile invariant for an info-disclosure surface.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/errorHandler.ts:194 (`message: error.message || copy.message`) is the same pattern for the plain `Error` branch: an arbitrary thrown JS Error's `.message` (e.g. a `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`) is surfaced verbatim to the user rather than the generic localized copy — a UX/quality gap in addition to the info-disclosure angle.

Impact: MEDIUM — information disclosure / poor error UX, gated on the backend actually emitting internal detail in `ErrorResponse.message` for 5xx (or an unhandled JS Error reaching parseApiError). Confidence MEDIUM (static-only): the passthrough sinks are confirmed by direct read; NOT confirmed here (no build/test, api-server not compiled in this cloud runner) is whether the Rust api-server already scrubs `message` to a safe string for 5xx. If it does, this is a defense-in-depth gap; if it does not, raw server internals reach the end user's screen.

Fix (cloud-landable, single-file frontend edit): in parseErrorResponse, prefer the localized catalogue copy over `data.message` for server-class statuses (statusCode >= 500) and for unknown/absent error codes — e.g. `const isServerClass = (statusCode ?? 0) >= 500; message: (!isServerClass && data.message) ? data.message : errorInfo.message`. Keep `data.message` for 4xx validation/business errors where it is user-actionable. Apply the same generic-copy fallback to the plain-Error branch (line 194). Verifies cleanly in the cloud runner (single-package ppt-web change, no backend/build coupling); errorHandler.test.ts already exists as the natural home for the new cases.
